sops.title: Candidate Registration E2E SOP
sops.purpose: To register a candidate account securely and confirm ownership of the email address before any use of the platform
inputs: Current versions of the legal documents accepted by candidates (SOP FR-A8)
steps: Open sign-up: Candidate selects 'I'm a worker' and enters email and password.
Validate password: System checks minimum 12 characters and rejects passwords found in breach lists.
Capture attestations: Candidate ticks age (18+) and consent to the legal documents required for candidates (SOP FR-A8); versions are recorded.
Create account: Auth record and profile row are created in 'pending confirmation' state.
Send confirmation: Confirmation email is sent via the EU email service; link valid 24 hours.
Confirm email: Candidate clicks the link; account becomes active; audit entry written.
Redirect to onboarding: Candidate is guided to create the profile.
Handle failures: Expired links can be re-requested; repeated attempts are rate-limited.
sops.risks: Fake accounts, weak credentials, unconfirmed emails
sops.controls: Breached-password check, email confirmation, rate limiting, consent versioning

sops.title: Employer Registration & Organisation Creation E2E SOP
sops.purpose: To register an employer user and create the company organisation with a single owner in one atomic step
inputs: Legal-entity identifier (company registration number, VAT number or another unique legal-entity identifier)
Consent to the legal documents required for employers (SOP FR-A8)
steps: Open sign-up: User selects 'I'm an employer'.
Create user: Steps of SOP FR-A1 apply (password policy, consent, confirmation).

Capture company details: Legal name, display name, country (ISO list), industry (ISIC list), website and the legal-entity identifier, recorded at the latest before checkout (to be confirmed by CHARA: which identifier is mandatory per country and how it is validated).

Create organisation atomically: System creates organisation and owner membership in one transaction; no subscription is created, and the organisation is on the restricted free plan until checkout (SOP FR-G2) (to be confirmed by CHARA: whether payment details are collected at registration or at checkout when the trial starts).

Verify uniqueness: Slug generated and checked; duplicate legal name warns but does not block; a legal-entity identifier that has already had a free trial is flagged, and that legal entity receives no second trial (SOP FR-G2).
Audit: Creation recorded with actor and organisation id.
Prompt security set-up: Owner is prompted to enrol two-step verification (SOP FR-A4).
Land on dashboard: Owner sees empty dashboard with guided next steps.
outputs: Legal-entity identifier recorded for trial eligibility
sops.risks: Duplicate companies, impersonation of real employers, orphaned organisations
sops.controls: Atomic creation, one-owner rule, legal-entity identifier check, audit, later business verification (Phase 3)

sops.title: Login, Logout & Password Recovery E2E SOP
sops.purpose: To authenticate users securely and allow self-service recovery
steps: Login: User submits credentials; failures are rate-limited and never reveal whether the email exists.
Issue session: Short-lived access token (30 min) and refresh cookie (7 days) are set; cookies are HTTP-only and secure.
Refresh transparently: The request proxy refreshes tokens before expiry.
Enforce MFA step-up: Privileged pages require two-step verification (SOP FR-A4).
Logout: Session revoked on the server; cookies cleared.
Request reset: User enters email; a single-use link valid 1 hour is emailed regardless of whether the account exists.
Reset password: New password validated against policy; all other sessions ended; confirmation email sent.
Audit: Login failures above threshold and all resets are logged.
sops.risks: Credential stuffing, session theft, account enumeration
sops.controls: Rate limits, breached-password check, secure cookies, uniform responses, session revocation

sops.title: Two-Step Verification Enrolment & Enforcement E2E SOP
sops.purpose: To require a second factor for roles that can see candidate documents, manage teams or payments
steps: Prompt enrolment: On first access to a protected area the user is redirected to the MFA page.
Generate secret: System shows a QR code and manual key.
Verify: User enters the first code; enrolment is confirmed.
Issue recovery codes: Ten single-use codes shown once; user confirms storage.
Elevate session: Session is marked at assurance level 2 for its lifetime.
Enforce: Database policies and page guards reject privileged actions without level 2.
Recover: Lost device uses a recovery code; support resets only after identity check and audit entry.
Review: Enrolment status visible in team and staff lists.
sops.risks: Account takeover of privileged users, lost devices
sops.controls: Mandatory enrolment, restrictive policies at database level, audited recovery

sops.title: Team Membership Management E2E SOP
sops.purpose: To add, change and remove organisation members with a single accountable owner at all times
steps: Invite: Owner/admin enters email and role; when limit enforcement is on, the plan's team-member limit (initially 1 / 5 / 15 for Basic / Professional / Enterprise; Enterprise adjustable per organisation) is checked and an upgrade prompt is shown if it is reached; otherwise an invitation with single-use token (7 days) is created and emailed (to be confirmed by CHARA: whether the Basic limit of 1 counts the owner, so that Basic cannot invite members).
Accept: Invitee signs in or registers as a company user and accepts; membership becomes active.
Reject workers: System refuses acceptance by a candidate account.
Change role: Owner/admin changes member role; system prevents removing the last owner.
Transfer ownership: Owner designates a new owner; both confirm; old owner becomes admin.
Remove member: Owner/admin removes; sessions of the removed member are revoked; access ends immediately.
Expire: Unaccepted invitations expire automatically.
Audit: Every invitation, acceptance, role change and removal is logged.
sops.risks: Unauthorised access after departure, loss of owner, invitation link abuse
sops.controls: Immediate revocation, one-owner rule, single-use expiring tokens, team-member limit by plan, audit

sops.title: Account Kind Assignment E2E SOP
sops.purpose: To fix each account as either candidate or company user at onboarding so that privacy and payment rules apply cleanly
steps: Present choice: After confirmation the user chooses 'worker' or 'company'.
Record kind: The choice is written once; later changes are rejected by the database.
Route onboarding: Workers go to profile creation; company users to organisation creation or invitation acceptance.
Enforce rules: Workers cannot be organisation members or start checkout; company users cannot create a worker profile.
Handle exceptions: A person needing both roles uses two accounts with different emails.
Audit: Kind assignment is logged.
sops.risks: Role confusion, workers charged by mistake
sops.controls: Immutable kind, database checks, clear UI copy

sops.title: Platform Staff Role Management E2E SOP
sops.purpose: To grant and revoke CHARA staff roles under four-eyes-style control with full audit
inputs: Role to grant (Platform Administrator, Verification Reviewer or Trust & Safety Administrator)
steps: Request: A Platform Administrator opens the staff page and enters the named user and one of the three roles with a reason.
Verify: System requires the Platform Administrator's session at assurance level 2 and rejects self-grant.
Grant: Role row is written for the named person; the permissions of the three roles are technically separated; audit entry records grantor, grantee, role and reason.
End sessions: The affected user's sessions are revoked so the new rights apply on next login.
Revoke: Same path with revocation timestamp; sessions revoked.
Bootstrap: The first Platform Administrator is created by a ticketed database insert recorded in the deploy runbook.

Named individuals: CHARA supplies the named individuals for each role before production deployment; no shared administrator account is used; further staff are added by this procedure without redevelopment.
Review: Quarterly access review lists all staff roles.
sops.risks: Privilege escalation, dormant staff accounts, shared accounts
sops.controls: Platform Administrator with MFA only, no self-grant, named accounts, technically separated role permissions, audit, quarterly review

sops.title: Consent Capture & Re-consent E2E SOP
sops.purpose: To record lawful consent to the current legal documents and refresh it when documents change
steps: Display: Sign-up form links to the current versions of the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy, and of the Worker Terms (candidates) or the Employer Terms (employers); checkout links to the Subscription and Billing Terms (to be confirmed by CHARA: which legal documents need recorded acceptance at sign-up and at checkout).
Record: On submit, at sign-up and at checkout, one consent row per document with version and timestamp is written.
Publish new version: Legal publication (SOP FR-F1) marks the new version current.
Detect: On next login the session helper compares consented versions with current versions.
Re-consent: User is shown the change summary and must accept before continuing.
Withdraw: Withdrawal inserts a new row; access that depends on the consent ends.
Evidence: Consent rows are append-only and exportable for audits.
sops.controls: Versioned documents, append-only ledger, forced re-consent

sops.title: Age Attestation E2E SOP
sops.purpose: To ensure candidates confirm legal working age without collecting a date of birth
steps: Present: Sign-up shows a mandatory 'I am 18 or older' checkbox.
Record: Attestation is stored as a consent purpose with version and time; no date of birth is stored.
Block: Sign-up cannot complete without attestation.
Handle reports: The Trust & Safety Administrator acts on reports of underage users under SOP FR-F1.
Review: Legal confirms the attestation wording per launch country.
sops.controls: Mandatory checkbox, data minimisation, moderation path

sops.title: Candidate Profile Creation & Maintenance E2E SOP
sops.purpose: To create a structured, reusable candidate profile using international code lists
steps: Create: Candidate enters name, headline and current country.
Select occupation: From the ISCO-08 list with search.
Add skills and languages: Skills as tags with suggestions; languages with CEFR level.
Set experience and availability: Years of experience; available now / from date / unavailable.
Set preferences: Preferred countries and industries.
Record work authorisation: Countries where the candidate may work and expiry dates.
Save: Data validated; profile private by default; audit of creation.
Maintain: Candidate edits at any time; completeness meter updates (SOP FR-B4).
sops.risks: Inaccurate data, sensitive data entered in free text
sops.controls: Controlled lists, validation, privacy by default, free-text guidance

sops.title: Document Upload & Management E2E SOP
sops.purpose: To store CVs and certificates privately and keep metadata consistent
steps: Register: Candidate chooses type and title; a metadata row is created first.
Issue upload link: System issues a short-lived signed upload URL to the candidate's private folder.
Upload: File is uploaded directly to private storage; type and size validated.
Mark status: Scan status recorded (download-only until scanning is introduced).
List and rename: Candidate manages documents from the Passport page.
Delete: Deletion removes the file and metadata; active shares referencing it are revoked.
Expire: Expiry dates (e.g. certificates) are stored and surfaced as reminders.
sops.controls: Type/size validation, metadata-first rule, private bucket, deletion cascade

sops.title: Profile Privacy by Default E2E SOP
sops.purpose: To guarantee that no employer sees candidate data without an application the candidate made
steps: Default: Profiles are created non-searchable; no employer-facing listing exists in Phase 1.
Access path: Employers see a candidate only through an application the candidate submitted.
Scope: Access is limited to the profile snapshot and the documents selected at application time.
Enforce: Database policies grant access only to members of the organisation that owns the job, while the share is active.
Revoke: Withdrawal or deletion ends access immediately.
Test: Cross-tenant negative tests run in every build.
sops.controls: Row-level security, negative tests, no search listing

sops.title: Profile Completeness Guidance E2E SOP
sops.purpose: To help candidates complete profiles that employers can act on
steps: Compute: Weighted score across identity, occupation, skills, languages, experience, availability, work authorisation and CV.
Display: Percentage and the next suggested item.
Nudge: Reminder email after 7 days below 60 % (respecting preferences).
Measure: Completion distribution reviewed monthly.
sops.controls: Transparent weights, periodic review

sops.title: Document Access Log Transparency E2E SOP
sops.purpose: To let candidates see exactly who accessed their documents and when
steps: Log: Every grant decision (allowed or denied) for a document writes an access-log entry with organisation, time and outcome.
Expose: A view returns only the candidate's own entries.
Display: Passport page lists accesses by organisation and document.
Retain: Entries kept 24 months by default; the period is a configuration value.
Investigate: Candidate can report suspicious access to the Trust & Safety Administrator.
sops.controls: Logging inside the grant function, no alternative download path

sops.title: Account Deletion & Erasure E2E SOP
sops.purpose: To honour deletion requests with a cooling-off period and lawful record keeping
steps: Request: Candidate requests deletion from settings; confirmation email sent.
Cooling-off: 30 days during which the candidate can cancel; account marked 'deletion requested'.
Check holds: Legal hold or open dispute pauses erasure; the designated privacy contact (a configured setting) is informed (to be confirmed by CHARA: who performs this role at launch).
Erase: Scheduler triggers erasure: profile and documents deleted, applications and audit entries pseudonymised, auth user removed.
Confirm: Completion recorded in audit; confirmation email to the address on file.
Report: Monthly count of requests and completion times.
kpis: Erasure within 30 days of cooling-off end (100 %)
sops.risks: Incomplete erasure, deleting data under legal hold
sops.controls: Scheduled job with checklist, legal-hold flag, audit

sops.title: Vacancy Creation E2E SOP
sops.purpose: To create complete, well-classified vacancies
steps: Open form: Admin starts a new vacancy (draft).
Enter details: Title, description, occupation (ISCO-08), industry (ISIC), country, city, employment type.
Enter terms: Salary range and currency, accommodation, visa support, recruitment preference (local/international/both).
Validate: Required fields and value lists checked; prohibited attributes are not available.
Save draft: Vacancy stored in Draft; audit entry.
Preview: Admin reviews the public rendering before publishing (SOP FR-C2).
kpis: Vacancies published within 1 day of creation
sops.controls: Controlled lists, validation, platform rules link, moderation

sops.title: Vacancy Lifecycle Management E2E SOP
sops.purpose: To control the states a vacancy passes through and what the public sees
steps: Publish: Admin sets Open; system checks plan limit (SOP FR-C6) and visibility rules.
Expose: Only Open and not-hidden vacancies are public and searchable.
Pause: Admin pauses; vacancy hidden from search but applications retained.
Close or fill: Admin closes or marks filled; open applications receive a final state update prompt.
Guard transitions: Database allows only valid transitions.
Audit: Every state change recorded.
sops.controls: Transition guard, reminders for stale vacancies, moderation

sops.title: Public Vacancy Search E2E SOP
sops.purpose: To let visitors and candidates find relevant vacancies quickly
steps: Enter criteria: Keyword and filters (country, city, occupation, industry, employment type, minimum salary, accommodation, visa support, local/international).
Execute: Search function returns only public vacancies, ranked by relevance then date, paginated.
Display: Result cards with key facts; no personal data.
Refine: Filters update results; URL reflects state for sharing.
Measure: Query performance monitored against the 500 ms target.
Index: Database indexes maintained for every filter.
sops.risks: Slow search, exposure of non-public vacancies
sops.controls: Indexed function, public-only rule in database, monitoring

sops.title: Vacancy Page Presentation E2E SOP
sops.purpose: To present a vacancy with the employer's public profile and clear actions
steps: Render: Vacancy details and employer card (name, country, industry, website).
Actions: Apply (requires candidate login) and Save.
Structured data: JobPosting markup added for search engines.
Hidden handling: Hidden or closed vacancies show a neutral 'no longer available' page.
Accessibility: Page passes automated checks.
sops.controls: Server rendering from live data, tests

sops.title: Saved Vacancies E2E SOP
sops.purpose: To let candidates keep a shortlist of vacancies
steps: Save: Candidate saves from search or vacancy page.
List: Saved page shows status (Open/closed) and quick apply.
Unsave: Candidate removes items.
Clean-up: Closed vacancies flagged; removed after 90 days.
sops.controls: Status flags, clean-up job

sops.title: Vacancy Plan Limit Enforcement E2E SOP
sops.purpose: To apply the number of open vacancies allowed by the organisation's plan
steps: Configure: Limits per plan are administrator-editable records, initially 3 / 15 / 50 open vacancies for Basic / Professional / Enterprise; Enterprise may have per-organisation values.
Check: On publish, a database trigger compares open count with the limit when the enforcement setting is on (to be confirmed by CHARA: the date on which limit enforcement is switched on).
Block and prompt: If exceeded, publish is refused with an upgrade prompt.

Downgrade handling: Existing vacancies are kept and never deleted; creating or reopening a vacancy over the new limit is blocked (to be confirmed by CHARA: behaviour on downgrade when usage exceeds the new plan's limit).
Go-live gate: Enforcement must be on in production (automated check).
sops.controls: Data-driven limits, go-live check, keep-not-delete

sops.title: Vacancy Moderation E2E SOP
sops.purpose: To remove unlawful or rule-breaking vacancies with a documented reason
steps: Receive: Report or routine review flags a vacancy.
Assess: The Trust & Safety Administrator checks against platform rules and law.
Act: Hide with a mandatory statement of reasons; employer notified by email with appeal route.
Appeal: Employer responds; the Trust & Safety Administrator decides within 7 days; decision recorded.
Restore: Unhide when resolved; audit entry.
Report: Monthly moderation statistics.
sops.controls: Mandatory reasons, appeal path, audit, two-person review for suspensions

sops.title: Job Application Submission E2E SOP
sops.purpose: To submit an application with explicit document sharing and consent
steps: Start: Candidate clicks Apply on an Open vacancy (login required); a general notice states that cross-border hiring can be subject to legal requirements.
Compose: Optional cover note; select which documents to share.
Consent: Candidate confirms sharing with the named employer for this application.
Create atomically: Consent, share, application, 'applied' event, audit and notification queue entry are written in one transaction.
Snapshot: Profile snapshot stored with the application.
Confirm: Candidate sees the application in the journey tracker; employer notified (SOP FR-D6).

Reject invalid: Closed vacancy, duplicate or missing profile fields are refused with guidance; in Phase 1 no monthly limit and no country-pair block applies to direct applications (to be confirmed by CHARA: whether the monthly candidate-submissions limit applies to direct applications; whether direct applications may go live for all country pairs before country-specific rules exist, subject to legal review).
sops.controls: Explicit selection and consent, atomic transaction, duplicate rule

sops.title: Application Status Pipeline E2E SOP
sops.purpose: To move applications through defined states with a complete event history
steps: Define states: Applied, Viewed, Shortlisted, Interview, Offer, Hired, Not selected, Withdrawn.
Change: Employer selects a new state (and optional note) from the applicant view or board.
Guard: Database allows only permitted transitions and actors.
Record: An event row with actor, from, to, note and time is appended.
Notify: Candidate email on each change except Viewed (SOP FR-D6).
Final states: Hired, Not selected, Withdrawn end the pipeline; shares expire after 30 days.
sops.controls: Transition guard, append-only events, notifications

sops.title: Candidate Journey Tracker E2E SOP
sops.purpose: To give candidates a clear view of every application's progress
steps: List: 'My applications' shows all applications with current stage and filters.
Timeline: Each application shows events in order with dates and notes shared with the candidate.
Next step: Plain-language text explains what usually happens next at each stage.
Act: Withdraw button available on non-final states.
Access: Only the candidate's own rows are readable (database rule).
sops.controls: Clear stage copy, own-rows-only policy

sops.title: Application Withdrawal E2E SOP
sops.purpose: To let candidates withdraw and immediately end the employer's document access
steps: Request: Candidate selects Withdraw and confirms.
Update: State set to Withdrawn; event appended.
Revoke: The share for that employer is revoked; further document access is denied and logged.
Notify: Employer sees the withdrawal in the pipeline; optional email.
Retain: Record kept per retention schedule for audit.
sops.controls: Revocation inside the same transaction, access tests

sops.title: Application Visibility Control E2E SOP
sops.purpose: To ensure each party sees only the applications they are entitled to
steps: Define: Candidates see own applications; organisation members see applications to their organisation's vacancies.
Enforce: Row-level policies implement the rule for applications, events and notes.
Separate notes: Internal notes are visible to the organisation only, never to the candidate.
Test: Positive and negative tests per role run in every build.
Audit: Attempts to access other organisations' data are logged by the database.
sops.controls: Row-level security, negative tests

sops.title: Application Notifications E2E SOP
sops.purpose: To inform candidates and employers of application events reliably
steps: Queue: Each event enqueues a notification unless preferences disable it.
Batch: Employer notifications are sent immediately or as a daily summary per preference.
Render: Templates filled with non-sensitive data only (no documents, no notes).
Send: Email service delivers; status recorded; retries with back-off on failure.
Monitor: Failed deliveries alert operations after 3 retries.
Review: Template wording reviewed with legal for tone and content.
sops.risks: Spam, leakage in emails, missed updates
sops.controls: Preferences, minimal payloads, retries, monitoring

sops.title: Duplicate Application Prevention E2E SOP
sops.purpose: To keep one active application per candidate and vacancy
steps: Check: Database unique rule rejects a second non-withdrawn application for the same vacancy.
Guide: UI shows the existing application instead of an error.
Allow re-apply: After withdrawal a new application is possible if the vacancy is still Open.
Monitor: Duplicate attempts counted for abuse detection.
sops.controls: Unique rule, rate limit

sops.title: Applicant List & Pipeline Board E2E SOP
sops.purpose: To give employers an organised view of applicants per vacancy
steps: Open vacancy: Member selects a vacancy from the dashboard.
List view: Applicants with stage, date, completeness and document count; sortable and filterable.
Board view: Columns per stage; drag or menu to move (triggers SOP FR-D2).
Counts: Stage counts update live.
Export: CSV export of the list without documents, on every paid plan (to be confirmed by CHARA: which plans include CSV export).
kpis: Time to first review of new applicants
sops.controls: New-applicant highlighting, digest emails

sops.title: Applicant Detail Review E2E SOP
sops.purpose: To review an applicant's profile and documents securely and keep team notes
steps: Open: Member opens the applicant; first open sets state Viewed.
Review snapshot: Profile as submitted; indicator if the live profile changed since.
Open documents: Each click requests a 60-second link through the access broker; access is logged for the candidate.
Add notes: Internal notes visible to the organisation only.
See history: Stage timeline with actors and notes.
Act: Change stage, shortlist, decline with reason.
sops.risks: Document leakage, notes exposed to candidate
sops.controls: Brokered links, access log, org-only note policy

sops.title: Bulk Applicant Actions E2E SOP
sops.purpose: To process many applicants consistently
steps: Select: Admin selects applicants in list or board.
Choose action: Move to stage or decline with a reason template.
Confirm: Summary shown; confirm.
Apply: Each application processed under the same transition guard; events and notifications generated individually.
Report: Result summary with any refused items.
sops.controls: Confirmation step, per-item guard, undo window for declines (24 h)

sops.title: Shortlisting E2E SOP
sops.purpose: To mark preferred applicants when the plan includes shortlisting
steps: Check feature: Database verifies the organisation's plan includes shortlisting; every paid plan includes it (to be confirmed by CHARA: whether shortlisting is included in all plans).
Flag: Member marks applicant as shortlisted; event appended.
Filter: Shortlist filter available in list and board.
Upsell: If not included (restricted free plan), UI shows upgrade prompt.
sops.controls: Feature check in database

sops.title: Employer Dashboard E2E SOP
sops.purpose: To summarise hiring activity and account status at a glance
steps: Aggregate: Open vacancies, new applications (7 days), applicants by stage, plan and trial status.
Display: Cards with links to detail views.
Refresh: Values computed from indexed queries on each load.
Alert: Trial-ending and payment issues shown prominently.
sops.controls: Direct queries, tests

sops.title: Platform Administration Console E2E SOP
sops.purpose: To administer users, organisations, vacancies, legal documents, plans, settings and staff with accountability and separated roles
inputs: Staff role (Platform Administrator, Verification Reviewer or Trust & Safety Administrator)
steps: Access: Staff signs in with MFA; console available only to staff roles, and each role sees only its own functions; the Verification Reviewer has no function in Phase 1.

Users: Search (Platform Administrator, Trust & Safety Administrator); suspend or reinstate with reason (Trust & Safety Administrator); view activity counts (to be confirmed by CHARA: whether a Platform Administrator may also suspend accounts).
Organisations: View, with members and vacancies (both roles); suspend with reason (Trust & Safety Administrator).
Vacancies: Hide or unhide with statement of reasons (Trust & Safety Administrator; SOP FR-C7).
Statistics: Application counts only; no personal documents (Platform Administrator).
Legal: Publish a new document version with change summary, which triggers re-consent (Platform Administrator).

Plans: Limits, features, trial days and per-organisation Enterprise limits are configuration records owned by the Platform Administrator; until the editing screens exist a change is made by a reviewed migration (to be confirmed by CHARA: whether the screens for editing plans and settings are delivered in Phase 1 or in a later phase).

Settings: Legal-entity details, privacy contact, data-protection contact and retention periods are configuration records owned by the Platform Administrator, changed the same way as plans (see Plans step).
Audit: Search the audit log by actor, action, entity and date (Platform Administrator).
Staff: Grant or revoke roles (Platform Administrator; SOP FR-A7).
sops.risks: Abuse of admin rights, missing reasons, one role acting outside its remit
sops.controls: MFA, technically separated role permissions, mandatory reasons, audit, quarterly access review

sops.title: Administrative Action Audit E2E SOP
sops.purpose: To keep an immutable record of every administrative action
steps: Capture: Every administrative RPC writes an audit row with actor, target, reason, time and request id.
Protect: Audit table permits inserts only; updates and deletes are blocked for all roles.
Retain: 6 years by default; the period is a configuration value.
Export: Monthly export to an immutable archive outside the platform.
Review: Sampled quarterly by the designated privacy contact.
sops.controls: Database trigger, off-platform archive, review

sops.title: Staff Document Access Restriction E2E SOP
sops.purpose: To ensure platform staff cannot access candidate documents in Phase 1
steps: Design: No administrative function requests document links.

Enforce: Database policies deny all three staff roles any read on document metadata and storage objects; reports are handled without document access (to be confirmed by CHARA: whether Trust & Safety must inspect reported documents at launch).
Test: Automated test asserts the denial in every build.
Exception process: Any future need requires a documented change, a legal basis and candidate-visible logging.
sops.controls: No code path, policy denial, tests

sops.title: Plan Configuration E2E SOP
sops.purpose: To define employer plans, prices, limits and features as controlled configuration
steps: Define: Three plans (Basic, also called Starter; Professional; Enterprise) with plan code, name, price, currency (EUR, exclusive of VAT), trial days (default 30) and visibility; the base plan is EUR 39 per month (to be confirmed by CHARA: prices of the Professional and Enterprise plans; display name of the lowest plan).

Set limits: Initial values for Basic / Professional / Enterprise are 3 / 15 / 50 open vacancies and 1 / 5 / 15 team members; Enterprise values can be set per organisation; limits of later-phase functions are entered with those functions.
Set features: Shortlisting, analytics etc. per plan; a plan lists only features delivered in the current release (to be confirmed by CHARA: that Phase 1 plans list Phase 1 features only).

Load: Initial values loaded as records via versioned seed; later changes to limits, features and trial days are owned by the Platform Administrator and, until the editing screens exist, made by a reviewed migration (to be confirmed by CHARA: whether the screens for editing plans and settings are delivered in Phase 1 or in a later phase).
Mirror in Stripe: Products and prices created/updated by script; identifiers stored.
Publish: Pricing page reads the records (SOP FR-H2).
Review: Quarterly pricing review.
kpis: Plans with all limits defined (100 % before launch)
sops.controls: Data-driven plans, reviewed seeds, audited changes, Stripe sync script, go-live check

sops.title: Subscription Checkout & Customer Portal E2E SOP
sops.purpose: To start and manage subscriptions through Stripe without handling card data
steps: Start: Owner/admin chooses a plan on the billing page (to be confirmed by CHARA: whether payment details are collected at registration or at checkout when the trial starts).

Validate: Function checks role, MFA, that the account is not a worker, and trial eligibility: one free trial per legal entity, so a legal-entity identifier that has already had a trial starts checkout without one.
Collect tax data: Billing country and VAT ID captured; Stripe Tax enabled; prices in EUR, exclusive of VAT.

Disclose: Before the redirect to Checkout the user is shown the trial period, the price after the trial, the billing frequency, the automatic conversion and the cancellation procedure, and accepts the Subscription and Billing Terms (SOP FR-A8; to be confirmed by CHARA: which legal documents need recorded acceptance at checkout).
Create session: Stripe Checkout session with the configured trial (default 30 days) and card required; the trial converts automatically to the selected paid plan when it ends.
Return: On success the webhook (SOP FR-G3) activates the trial; user returns to billing page.
Manage: Customer Portal link for card updates, plan change, cancellation and invoices.
Audit: Checkout start and portal visits logged.
sops.risks: Card data exposure, wrong tax, repeated free trials, unclear trial terms
sops.controls: Hosted checkout, Stripe Tax, role/MFA checks, one trial per legal entity, disclosure before the trial

sops.title: Payment Webhook Processing E2E SOP
sops.purpose: To apply Stripe events exactly once and keep subscription state correct
steps: Receive: Webhook function receives the event.
Verify: Signature checked; invalid signatures rejected and logged.
Ingest: Event stored by provider event id; duplicates acknowledged without re-processing.
Apply: Subscription state updated according to event type; audit row written.
Retry: Failed applications retried by scheduler every 5 minutes; alert after 1 hour.
Reconcile: Weekly comparison of Stripe subscriptions with records.
sops.controls: Signature verification, idempotency, reconciliation

sops.title: Subscription State & Fallback E2E SOP
sops.purpose: To manage trial, active, past-due and cancelled states and what each allows
steps: Trial: Starts at checkout; ends after the configured trial period (default 30 days) and converts automatically to the selected paid plan; reminder 3 days before.
Active: Paid invoice sets active; full plan rights.
Past due: Failed payment sets past due with 7-day grace; email and dashboard warning.
Cancelled: After grace or on cancellation; organisation falls to the free plan: no open vacancies, read-only applicants.
Reactivate: Checkout again restores the plan; paused vacancies can be reopened.
Record: Every transition audited.
sops.controls: Scheduled transitions, grace period, data retained

sops.title: Billing Page E2E SOP
sops.purpose: To show owners their plan, usage and invoices and let them act
steps: Display: Current plan, state, trial or renewal date, usage versus limits.
Actions: Upgrade, downgrade, open portal, change tax details.
Invoices: Link to Stripe-hosted invoices.
Access: Owners/admins with MFA only.
sops.controls: Role and MFA gate

sops.title: Worker No-Fee Guarantee E2E SOP
sops.purpose: To ensure candidates can never be charged
steps: Rule: Database rejects checkout and subscriptions for worker accounts.
UI: No pricing or payment elements in candidate areas.
Test: Automated test attempts a worker checkout and expects refusal.
Policy: Platform Rules state that workers never pay; reports of fee requests go to the Trust & Safety Administrator.
sops.controls: Database rule, tests, policy

sops.title: Public Website Publication E2E SOP
sops.purpose: To publish and maintain the public pages
steps: Prepare: Texts for Home, How CHARA Works, Trust & Safety, About, Contact approved by CHARA; legal pages follow SOP FR-H3.
Settings: Legal-entity details, privacy contact and data-protection contact shown on the Imprint, Privacy and Contact pages are read from configurable settings.
Build: Pages rendered server-side with shared layout and accessibility checks.
Review: Content and legal review before release.
Publish: Deployed with the release; sitemap updated.
Maintain: Quarterly content review.
sops.controls: Review workflow, automated checks

sops.title: Pricing Page from Configuration E2E SOP
sops.purpose: To display prices that always match the billing configuration
steps: Read: Page reads public plan records at render time.

Display: Worker free; the public employer plans (Basic and Professional; Enterprise once its price is confirmed) with prices in EUR labelled 'excl. VAT', the base plan at EUR 39 per month, and the trial terms (trial period, price after trial, automatic conversion) (to be confirmed by CHARA: prices of the Professional and Enterprise plans; display name of the lowest plan).
Change: Price changes made in configuration (SOP FR-G1) appear automatically.
Verify: Test compares page values with records.
sops.risks: Advertised price differs from charged price
sops.controls: Single source of truth, test

sops.title: Legal Document Versioning & Publication E2E SOP
sops.purpose: To publish legal documents with version control and consent linkage
inputs: Structured draft approved by legal counsel
steps: Draft: The team prepares a structured draft and change summary; legal counsel reviews and approves it; an unapproved text is marked as a draft.

Scope: Phase 1 documents are Terms of Service, Privacy Policy, Cookie Policy, Platform Rules, Acceptable Use Policy, Subscription and Billing Terms, Employer Terms, Worker Terms, Complaints and Dispute Process, and Account Suspension and Termination Rules; the other documents follow with their features (to be confirmed by CHARA: which of the eighteen legal documents are needed at the Phase 1 launch).
Review: Platform Administrator checks formatting and links.
Publish: New version created with number and date (SOP FR-F1); previous versions retained.
Trigger: Re-consent required at next login (SOP FR-A8).
Display: Legal pages show current version, date and change log.
Archive: All versions exportable for audit.
sops.controls: Versioned records, approval by legal counsel, audit

sops.title: Public Statistics E2E SOP
sops.purpose: To show real platform numbers without exposing individuals
steps: Compute: Scheduled job refreshes counts of open vacancies, employers, candidates and countries.
Threshold: Any value below 5 is hidden.
Display: Home page reads the anonymised view.
Verify: Test checks threshold behaviour.
sops.controls: Threshold, real data only

sops.title: Search Engine Readiness E2E SOP
sops.purpose: To make vacancies discoverable by search engines
steps: Metadata: Each page has title and description.
Sitemap and robots: Generated from live data; private areas excluded.
Structured data: JobPosting markup on vacancy pages validated.
Monitor: Search console errors reviewed monthly.
sops.controls: Robots rules, tests

sops.title: Account Email Delivery E2E SOP
sops.purpose: To deliver authentication emails reliably from a verified domain
steps: Set up: Domain authenticated (SPF, DKIM, DMARC); provider configured as SMTP for authentication emails; the provider is Resend (EU region).
Templates: Confirmation, reset, invitation, MFA recovery reviewed for wording.
Send: Authentication service sends on each event.
Monitor: Bounce and complaint rates reviewed weekly.
Rotate: Provider credentials rotated per key-rotation runbook.
sops.controls: Domain authentication, monitoring

sops.title: Transactional Email Queue E2E SOP
sops.purpose: To send platform emails through a queue with retries and status
steps: Enqueue: Events add messages to the queue respecting preferences.
Consume: Scheduled function picks messages every minute.
Render: Templates filled with minimal data.
Send and record: Provider response stored; failures retried with back-off up to 3 times.
Alert: Backlog above threshold or repeated failures alert operations.
Retain: Notification records 13 months by default; the period is a configuration value.
sops.controls: Queue with visibility timeout, idempotent send keys

sops.title: Notification Preferences E2E SOP
sops.purpose: To respect user choices about notifications
steps: Default: Application updates on; employer digest off (immediate).
Change: User updates preferences in settings; stored per user.
Apply: Enqueue step checks preferences; mandatory security and legal emails are always sent.
Audit: Preference changes logged.
sops.controls: Check at enqueue, tests
